x: Ted Jackman and Jim Latter had a determined struggle for second place, but Latter's earlier efforts in catching the leaders had sapped his strength, and Jackman was able to draw away in the last hundred yards.

The 880 yards handicap was won by our popular handicapper, Ernie Duffett, although we must add quickly that it was not reward for his persistence. The Walk provided ever-improving Jim Latter with yet another win. He won't be happy till he's on the scratch mark!
